news.title: U15 team take Maldives' first goals, point in FIFA World Cup
news.lede: The very first edition of the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival, open to all FIFA member nations, has seen Maldives equalize 3-3 against Anguilla, making the three goals and singular point the very first Maldives has gotten in a FIFA World Cup. Maldives drew against the small Caribbean nation Anguilla with a comeback. The FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival is taking place in Baku, Azerbaijan. The match played yesterday saw Anguilla's Jacob Fleming and Spawndel Pogson's goals early in the second half put them in a three-goal lead.

news.title: De la Fuente wins men’s Ballon d’Or coach of the year after leading Spain to World Cup title
news.lede: Spanish coach Luis de la Fuente won the men's coach of the year award at the 2026 Ballon d'Or. LONDON – Luis de la Fuente won the Ballon d’Or for men’s coach of the year on Oct 26 after leading Spain to World Cup glory. “Teamwork makes us invincible. This is a great honour,” de la Fuente said after collecting the award at a ceremony in London.

news.title: The Third Day of the Main Competition at the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival 2026 Featured Exciting Matches and Special Moments
news.lede: AFFA President Rovshan Najaf attended both of the Azerbaijan national team’s matches that day. He also met with the players and had a friendly conversation with them. FIFA President Gianni Infantino also visited the Hovsan Competition Complex during the day. He watched several matches, visited the competition pitches, and spoke with players and staff involved in organising the tournament.

news.title: New Zealand wrap up group fixtures at FIFA U-15 Boys World Cup
news.lede: New Zealand have finished their five group fixtures at the FIFA U-15 Boys’ World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan. They lost 4-2 to Puerto Rico, then were edged 1-0 by Mozambique. Main photo: New Zealand’s squad at the FIFA U-15 Boys’ World Cup. Photo credit: Aziz Karimov – FIFA/FIFA via Getty Images.

news.title: 'Success is a motivation, not the end goal' - World Cup winner Luis de la Fuente reacts to Ballon d'Or coach award
news.lede: Luis de la Fuente has cemented his legacy as one of the modern greats after being named the best coach in world football. The Spanish tactician accepted the prestigious award following a historic campaign that saw his national team reach the summit of the sport.A night of glory for the Spanish mastermindDe la Fuente has officially been crowned the world's best coach after receiving the Johan Cruyff Trophy at the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony . The veteran manager was the clear favourite for the accolade following Spain's dominant run to the World Cup title, where his side captivated fans with a blend of tactical discipline and creative flair.Standing on the stage to accept the trophy, De la Fuente remained humble despite the magnitude of the occasion. He was quick to acknowledge the quality of his peers and the collective effort required to reach such heights.
